quote: A US$22.58 million contract was inked on Wednesday for the construction of a 15-megawatt (MW) solar farm in Linden … A Chinese joint venture between SUMEC Complete Equipment and Engineering Company and XJ Group Corporation has undertaken the project
note: Opened News Room Guyana 21 May 2025; SUMEC company Chinese release 22 May 2025 corroborates 15 MW + 22 MWh.
